current_events: Israeli forces withdraw from areas around Hebron in the occupied West Bank after a multi-day operation following the killing of two Israeli soldiers at a checkpoint
At least 24 people are killed, five others are injured, and 27 are missing during Russian bombing on an aid distribution centre in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast. Ukraine
Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war
A truck bomb explodes near a military base in Planadas, Tolima Department, Colombia, killing four people, including a baby, and wounding several others

An improvised device blasts was thrown at the home of Marcelino Huamán, the mayor-elect of the Villa El Salvador district (a municipality located south of Lima),leaving only material damage. The politician attributed the incident this Monday to an act of intimidation, following a previous attack he experienced last August
A double attack against against two Drug rehabilitation centers left three people killed and five wounded in Mazatlán, Sinaloa, México

The United States Food and Drug Administration approves the first generic version of lenacapavir, a twice-yearly HIV prevention injection expected to cost about US$40 annually in 120 low- and middle-income countries
A second wave of cyberattacks target freezers and refrigerators in supermarkets in multiple European countries, causing them to overheat and spoil

The Spanish interior ministry reportedly deports 16 migrants, including those from Bangladesh, Cameroon, Nigeria, Senegal, and Yemen, from Ceuta to Morocco following the migrant crisis in July. Amnesty International raises concerns with the move given Morocco's human rights violations
